tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background (the site's cream paper; maroon-black at night).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, aside boxes, the news ticker and the article sidebar.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet fills behind grouped content: stat strips, form fields.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on surface, surface-raised and surface-soft. 19:1 light, 19:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: dates, excerpts, captions on surface and surface-raised. 6.2:1 light, 8.7-9.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders around cards, grid cells and dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Ruled grids (project grid, focus-area grid, stat strip).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: FTU red. Primary buttons, the CTAS mark square, the 4px top rule on cards and covers, label bars. on-brand white holds 6.9:1 light, 5.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Red text: eyebrows, dates in meta rows, status labels, link hover. 6.8:1 on surface (light); blush 10-11:1 on maroon surfaces (dark).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand fills.

tokens.name: maroon
tokens.usage: Dark bands: the products band, the ftu.edu.vn top bar, the footer, the 'LET'S TALK' block. Text on it is cream.

tokens.name: maroon-deep
tokens.usage: Default (non-brand) button fill and the very top FTU bar.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Text on maroon and maroon-deep. 16.8:1 on maroon.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Highlight card fill in the products band (FTULLM), eyebrow dot, bullet squares on maroon. Text on it is maroon-deep (11.4:1).

tokens.name: blush-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary copy on maroon bands. 13:1 on maroon.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Tag and category chip background; hover wash on grid cells. Pair with brand-ink text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, 2px offset, on every interactive element. 6.8:1 on surface (light), 11.4:1 (dark).

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: space-9

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything rectangular: cards, buttons, inputs, chips, images. The CMU-style square system has no other radius for UI.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Only circular marks: the FTU seal and the round 'Liên hệ' CTA.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only the floating news ticker over the hero. Cards use borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: rule-top
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured top rule on article covers, aside boxes and lecturer name plates.

tokens.name: rule-side
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured left rule on pull quotes (FTU Labs motto).

tokens.usage: All card and grid borders.
